not_open: The knowledge base isn’t ready yet. Try again later.
disabled: This assistant has turned off the knowledge base.
read_only: The knowledge base is read-only. Changes are unavailable.
source_settings_forbidden: Only the owner can change a project’s source settings.
unknown_kind: Unknown kind: search one of projects, chats, people, docs, meetings, events, recordings or topics.
parent_self: A project can’t sit under itself.
parent_cycle: That project is already under this one, so this one can’t go under it.
parent_not_found: That parent project doesn’t exist, was merged into another or isn’t a project.
parent_with_merge: Change the parent or milestones separately from a merge or unmerge.
milestone_invalid: That milestone isn’t valid: it needs a title, a date like 2026-12-31 if any, and the state open, accepted or not accepted.
milestone_not_found: That milestone isn’t on this project any more.
